messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up — customer Acme reported quota/billing showing partner's key charged for calls that were actually exchanged to Acme SA. traced a couple of requests, looks wrong.

jia: Can you paste a request id so I can pull the trace?

rachel: req=01FJZ9M4. trace shows /v1/token_exchange returned 200 with subject=sa-acme-42, but meter logs show partner:ps-key-9 as the attributed key.

tom: That's probably the attribution ordering bug. router attributes by X-Request-Key unless X-Effective-Principal is present and validated. our exchange finishes after router makes the decision when the exchange is async.

rachel: So we sometimes attribute to proxy key even though exchange succeeded a few ms later. customers see quota burned on partner keys and get confused.

console-team: UX impact is bad — people will escalate. We should surface an "attributed entity" column in request logs and a flag for "attribution fallback". Also show exchange latency per request so CS can explain.

jia: Short-term mitigation idea: router should consult an exchange-cache (etcd) for pending exchanges for a given key_id and wait up to 100ms for an exchange result before falling back to key attribution. That avoids a full sync exchange.

tom: I like that. Add metrics too: auth_attribution_delays_ms and auth_attribution_fallback_count so we can measure regressions.

sre-bot: ALERT: auth attribution fallback spike — 84 events in last 5m for partner:ps-key-9. Paging oncall.

security: Important: any console surface that shows customer SA/subject must be RBAC gated (owner/admin). Also audit logs must record whether attribution used fallback or exchange result. We cannot leak other org ids to non-admins.

rachel: Agreed on gating. Proposed plan: 1) tom will PR router change behind an opt-in feature flag, 2) jia will add metrics and a small probe that validates exchange-cache TTLs, 3) console-team will add an "Attribution" column + "Exchange latency" to request logs behind admin toggle, 4) security will add audit flag and review.

console-team: For the UI tile we'll show: request_id, timestamp, attributed_entity ("key:partner:ps-key-9" or "sa:sa-acme-42"), exchange_latency_ms, fallback=true/false, and a link to trace. Keep it collapsible by default.

jia: PoC trace lookup command: `curl -sS \"https://traces.internal/trace/01FJZ9M4\" | jq .spans[] | grep token_exchange` — returns the span with tags.exchange_result. I'll wire a trace link.

tom: Also suggests a backfill job: re-run attribution for last 48h traces to correct telemetry/billing where possible. We should rate-limit it.

rachel: Timeline: metrics + probe in the next 48h, router opt-in flag early next week, console change (admin toggle) in ~2w, backfill research after that. I'll open the tickets and tag customers.

sre-bot: NOTE: paging suppressed — oncall acknowledged.

rachel: Thanks team — please include checklist items in PR descriptions and link customer support note. I'll draft comms. :thumbsup:
